Browse gut-friendly recipes, free, no account
See full nutrition data before you cook
Build the week around what you will eat

headline: EPA-rich. Full nutrition data.
subhead: Every recipe shows what is in it, so nothing has to be guessed or googled.
point1body:
EPA and omega-3 content, stated plainly
Complete nutrition data per dish
Everything you need before you shop
update: Know what is on the plate.
note: Browse the recipes and read the numbers for yourself.

headline: Cooking for the whole house?
subhead: Build a weekly plan that works for you and the people eating with you.
point1:
3 things the planner
does for families
point1body:
One weekly plan, not separate meals
Recipes anyone at the table will eat
Nutrition data for every portion
note: Build a weekly plan the whole household can eat.

headline: Nobody plans the hard part.
subhead: Deciding what to eat is easy on Sunday and impossible at six on Thursday.
point1:
3 decisions the plan
makes in advance
point1body:
What is for dinner, already answered
What to buy, decided on one list
What the nutrition adds up to
note: Spend ten minutes now and skip seven decisions later.

headline: Restriction is not a meal plan.
subhead: A list of foods to avoid leaves you with nothing to cook on a Tuesday.
point1:
3 things a plan does
that a list does not
point1body:
Tells you what to eat, not what to avoid
Shows the nutrition you are getting
Fits a real week, not an ideal one
update: Start from what you can eat.
note: Browse gut-friendly recipes and build from there.

headline: Free to browse. Free to save.
subhead: Read every recipe without an account. Saving a plan takes two clicks.
point1body:
Browsing every recipe and its nutrition
Building a full weekly plan
Saving it, once your free account exists
note: Browse now and save your plan in two clicks.

headline: Sunday shop. Thursday takeaway.
subhead: Plans fail in the gap between good intentions and a tired weeknight.
point1body:
Nothing decided before you are hungry
Recipes that need what you did not buy
No idea what the week adds up to
note: Build a week you will still follow on Thursday.

headline: Why EPA keeps coming up.
subhead: These recipes are built around EPA-rich ingredients, with the numbers shown.
point1:
3 things to look for
in every recipe
point1body:
EPA content, stated on the recipe itself
The full nutrition breakdown beneath it
Ingredients chosen to be gut-friendly
update: Read the numbers, not the claims.
note: Browse the recipes and see the data on each one.

headline: Saved plans, not saved screenshots.
subhead: Your weekly plan lives in your dashboard, private to you, ready to reuse.
point1:
3 things saving
a plan gets you
point1body:
A week you can repeat without rebuilding
A plan stored privately, visible only to you
Everything beside your other saved tools
note: Save your plan and it is there next week.

headline: Start with one meal, not seven.
subhead: Browse until one recipe looks worth cooking, then let the week build around it.
point1body:
Pick one recipe you would actually cook
Add a second when the first works
Let the plan fill in around them
note: Find one recipe today and build the week from it.
